unknowns.explanation: Four Hostage edge claims remain uncertain: the fish branch tap, the rising SWAT INJURED tap, the stage-to-FAIL TO NEGOTIATE tap, and whether Friendly Approach also reaches FAIL TO NEGOTIATE. A separate selected-path chart traces Cold Approach → FAIL TO NEGOTIATE and FAIL TO NEGOTIATE → DEVIANT JUMPS WITH EMMA. The Friendly candidate preserves the old ?edge=89 link but is not a confirmed extra connector in the 36-connector Steam image. This is chart-reading uncertainty, not gameplay uncertainty. The SAVE WOUNDED COP → Meet Cop prerequisite is separately guide-supported.
